_comment: Preguntas ORIGINALES tipo NIE del capítulo 1.10. No son preguntas reales del examen. Comprueba con tu edición 2027.

questions.scenario: A person is arrested in the street. Where must they normally be taken and when?
options: To a police station as soon as practicable after arrest

questions.scenario: When can taking an arrested person to a police station be delayed?
options: When their presence elsewhere is necessary for investigations reasonably required immediately (s. 30(10))
When the custody suite is busy

questions.scenario: On the way to custody, CCTV shows the arrested man was not involved and no grounds remain. What must the officer do?
options: Release him without bail and record it (s. 30(7))

questions.scenario: If a s. 30(10) delay occurs, what must be done?
options: The reasons for the delay must be recorded on arrival at the police station

questions.scenario: What is street bail (s. 30A)?
options: Releasing an arrested person before reaching a police station, on bail to attend a station later

questions.scenario: Which condition can NOT be imposed on street bail (⚠ check)?
options: A requirement to reside in a bail hostel
Not to enter a certain area

questions.scenario: What must a person released on street bail be given?
options: A written notice including the offence, grounds and when/where to attend

questions.scenario: A person on street bail fails to attend the station as required. Which is correct?
options: They may be arrested without warrant (s. 30D)

questions.scenario: Under s. 34 PACE, when must the custody officer order immediate release?
options: When grounds for detention have ceased and there are no other lawful grounds

questions.scenario: Which test governs the use of pre-charge bail since the 2022 reforms (⚠ check)?
options: Bail where necessary and proportionate (e.g. to protect victims)

questions.scenario: A suspect is released without bail while enquiries continue. This is…
Which section gives a power to arrest a person who fails to answer police bail at a station?
Is breaching a pre-charge bail condition itself a criminal offence?
options: No – but it gives a power of arrest

questions.scenario: An officer arrests a suspect and needs to search his flat under s. 32 immediately before going to custody. Which is correct?
options: Delay is permitted under s. 30(10) if reasonably required immediately

questions.scenario: Pre-charge bail periods and authorisation levels are found mainly in which part of PACE (and amended in 2022)?
Who decides on release after charge and whether bail is refused?
A person is released and told 'no further action'. What does this mean?
options: The investigation has ended with no charge

questions.scenario: What is the main purpose of bail conditions?
options: To secure attendance and prevent offending, interference with witnesses, or for protection

questions.scenario: Which of these is a lawful reason to delay taking someone to the station under s. 30(10)?
options: Searching the place of arrest for a discarded weapon
Taking the suspect home to change

questions.scenario: Street bail is mainly provided by which section?
